description: Local literature corpus for M5's PaperQA-style adapter. Invented SiPh papers under the reserved 10.5555 DOI prefix; no network, no publisher API.

papers.title: Series resistance extraction in carrier-depletion phase shifters

passages.text: Normalising the extracted series resistance by the taper-inclusive length overstates Rs per unit length by the ratio of the lengths, while leaving its bias dependence unchanged.
An open contact via produces a series resistance that is large and nearly independent of reverse bias.

papers.title: Mesh sensitivity of simulated access resistance

passages.text: Refining the access-region mesh below ten nanometres changed the extracted series resistance by less than one percent, whereas a forty nanometre edge inflated it by more than half; mesh studies should precede any physical interpretation of a flat, high Rs.

papers.title: Counter-doping and resistance in rib modulators

passages.text: Counter-doping of the rib raises the series resistance of the undepleted access path.
